notes: The supplied *by* was placed on the participial nominal מְבַקְשֵׁי under rule 33 rather than marked `added`, since the noun it stands before is written.

*driven to and fro* was kept whole as one rendering of the Niphal participle נִדָּף, whose own sense is being driven about; the internal *and* coordinates the parts of that rendering rather than two source items (rule 14's closing sentence) and the head stays on *driven* (rule 44). Reading *to and fro* as a surplus particle `added` under rule 44 was the competing analysis.
